title: TopologySemanticContextResolveIntent
description: Bounded semantic hints supplied by agent-core when resolving topology scoped context. These are recall-oriented candidates, not eligibility decisions.

candidateCatalogIds.description: High-recall semantic catalog ids that may match the user request. topology-service intersects these with the active topology artifact and runtime availability.

includeUnavailableSignals.description: Whether the response should include known but currently unavailable overlay signals with structured unavailable reasons.

maxOverlaySignals.description: Optional response shaping limit for overlay signal availability cards.
